text: Your task is to draw straight lines. Which tool can help? Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I can use a ruler to draw lines.
Your task is to erase pencil marks. Which tool can help? Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I can use an eraser to erase pencil marks.
Your task is to write notes on paper. Which tool can help? Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I can use a notebook to write notes.
Your task is to carry school things. What do you use, and why? Say a full sentence.
I use a backpack to carry school things.
Your task is to make straight lines. What do you use, and why? Say a full sentence.
I use a ruler to draw straight lines.
Your task is to remove pencil marks. What do you use, and why? Say a full sentence.
I use an eraser to erase pencil marks.
You want to draw straight lines. Which tool helps, and why?
I use a ruler to draw lines.
Now make pencil marks go away. Which tool helps, and why?
I use an eraser to erase marks.
Find and fix one word.
I use a ruler to draw lines.
